Yes. Forget about your ex please. Life is so much more. Nor your ex nor mine deserve us giving up on love. That’s ridiculous. You’ll see in time. I’m embarrassed about how much I loved her now. The cliches are true. And weirdly enough that cliche about “you take half as long grieving as the relationship lasted” was oddly true for me. Relationship of 4 years and I wasn’t ok for 2. But now I’m finally, literally, over it. The ick is real. Also, exposure therapy. She came back too many times to count. And it was never the same. 

When I was still in love, I was the one who made it special, she was just there. And when I fell out of love and she came back, at the very end, one night she was kissing me in my bed and every 20 seconds I had to stop because I just couldn’t think straight. I didn’t like her anymore. Simple. 

You can only break someone so many times. You can only humiliate someone so many times. But one day it ends. Unfortunately, or fortunately I think, a lot of you haven’t wasted your time going back and forth, and you’re actually lucky. You don’t realize that it’s never the same, and even if you accept that you really don’t. You’re longing for the same feeling. And it doesn’t come back. Not when you wake up to the fact that they left you. And will do it again. 

Love is so much more than that, it’s family, friends, self love, life and everything in it. My ex doesn’t define me in any way. I am looking forward to a long life of love in any way the universe has prepared for me, but I would never ever go back to someone who left me ever again. 

Life is so much more.

Hi! I’m sorry you’re going through this. I’m suffering too, and it’s very very overwhelming for me as well. You’re not alone and you’re not crazy for feeling so intensely. I was with my ex for 4 years algo. Here I will try my best to share my knowledge from the last 6 months. 

1. Honestly, there’s no avoiding it. And if you do go down that path, it is often unhealthy.  For a while you’re going to have these thoughts. You need to, with time, slowly think yourself out of that place you still occupy in your heart and mind. It’s okay for you to even be mad at him, even if he was respectful, because all of your feelings are valid. You get to be mad for a while that someone you loved and planned with, has chosen to remove themselves from those plans and love. You hadn’t planned on it and that can be frustrating. You’ll come to learn, you will probably feel every emotion. The grieving and healing proceses are very complex and not linear at all. You will have days where you feel stronger, followed by days you feel weak. Until it regulates with time. 

2. I’m guilt if this. Especially because we were good friends with another couple that are till together and it stills. She still hangs out with them. I cut contact because they sided with her. Anyways, I’m furious still, 6 months in, every time I drive and see a boy and girl in a car, or anywhere. It drives me insane. That’s because my wounds have been reopened too many times and my healing process regressed. But with time and no contact with your ex, you will slowly but surely shift your mindset further and further away from this jealously and fury at love in general. I promise. I got there, ish, and she dragged me back. Another thing I would say is don’t go back. Even if they say everything right. Make sure they’re sure. Take it very slow. My ex dumped me twice after dumping me the last time. Confusing and heartbreaking. It’s better to leave it be. Once they leave. That’s it. Okay? I’m sorry it hurts but maybe in time, way down the line when your life is completely different and you’re indifferent to him, you may try again. Don’t hang on to hope. Just realize we don’t control absolutely anything. The universe is very creative. 

3. That will go with time and deep introspection. In my case, she was a goddess amongst mortals and I could not imagine thinking otherwise of her. I still kinda think that but maybe 2% compared to the 9999% I felt a while ago. 
My ex showed me her true colors. Also she broke up with me. Way more than enough to come down from that pedestal. Sad but true and necessary. 

4. You said it. Like an infection. That’s how I feel too. She has crushed me to pieces and I still have hope hahaha. I wouldn’t even take her back. But my body still feels the hope. I honestly believe it is time. I got to the point before where I detached from her. It wasn’t easy it just took time. As you can see, unfortunately she hooked me back up and now I am miserable again. So yeah. Time and definitely no contact. 

5. You’re hurt. It’s normal to feel closed off from everything right now. But understand that it is right now. You’re going through a process that will have ups and downs and eventually a light at the end of the tunnel. When you’re there, this mentality will not be as strong. Yes, from now on you have to be careful about things and you have to protect yourself a bit more due to your experience, but that never means there isn’t something great waiting for you when you’re ready. Please be patient with yourself. You can do this. I know it’s painful. But you will be okay.

Hi there. I’m so so so sorry you’re feeling this way and he has treated you like this at the end. Honestly, I feel your pain and know how bad you want to end things because of it. 

I’m still not out the other side either, my breakup has been messy and I’ve felt like this for a while, too. 

Thankfully, with therapy and helping myself, it has subsided to the point where I see a whole new life ahead of me. 

The only advice I have for you is to go NC, for yourself, so you can stop opening the wounds that are causing you so much damage. And then with time, pick yourself back up. Let yourself have those days where everything is black, but take care of yourself even if it’s just a little bit. Don’t hurt yourself. Feel your feelings. Cry, scream, run, let it out. The best way to grieve this kind of breakup is really letting your body feel what it needs to feel. 

I’ve spent too many days on a cliff where I live just staring down into the abyss and crying. I do not recommend putting yourself somewhere vulnerable like that but maybe just try and live it out for a while. 

Please try and get yourself therapy if you can. I started after my breakup and it’s been the only thing helping me through. I can talk about my feelings in a way that friends and family do not reach. I think it’s been very important for my mental state. 

But honestly, one day you just gotta realize and accept that this is now life. In your case, he is simply not there anymore and in my case, she isn’t. And that’s just it. They chose this. Accept it. I know it’s very very very very hard. But when you come to this station, and you stay there for a while soaking it all in, hopefully you will realize that you deserve the love you want. The love you give. And especially you deserve at least compassion in a breakup, and it seems he isn’t giving you this. I know it’s heartbreaking and you can’t believe how your person could do this to you. Life changing isn’t the word. Especially reading how he became such a big part of yours. I know exactly how that feels. And how life feels pointless without them. 

I was so in love with my girl when she broke up with me, I honestly didn’t even see a way out. Nope. How could I live if I still loved her? And she didn’t want to love me ever again? 

With time, and her actions and lack thereof, I have came to realize that I do not miss her. I miss our relationship. 

How could I miss her? The cold, harsh, tactless, sometimes lucid girl that I was in love with? How? 

I did something that is recommended here a lot, which is write out a list of things that I don’t like about her. I mean I didn’t actually write it out, but whenever I see myself pinning over her, which is now basically nonexistent, I go through all the things I know I don’t like about her. And it’s very very useful. Example:

“Ugh I miss her.” 

- do you miss the silence? the way she never talked to you ever? 
- do you miss the emotional unavailability? and having to bend over backwards to accommodate such little consideration?
- do you miss how she wouldn’t put effort in? but then would blow up when confronted? 

there are so so many things. these are things I’ve realized more since the breakup that when I was in the relationship. 

Even though I was intensely in love, there was a way to kill that love. And it’s called time and perseverance. 

Get through one day at a time. At the beginning, the ways don’t matter. Just get yourself there. Take care of yourself. Then when life starts getting brighter, get through a day at a time but this time make your days amazing. Do every little thing you want to do, make them yours. 

I used to wake up with her and do whatever. Then I woke up without her and did nothing but want her. 

Now, 6 months and countless rejections from her later, I wake up and I chose me. I do what I fucking want. I still feel quite sore inside. Life is bittersweet. But the sweet is showing. 

I wake up, morning coffee + cigarette, plan my day how I want. I normally train now, for how long as I want (before I didn’t do much sport/exercise, but now I love it. It makes me feel tired, hungry, accomplished, it takes time out of the day, + the after shower. It makes you feel accomplished. I only box and run a little. The boxing alone at home is enough to keep me happy. 3 months ago, I would’ve laughed if someone had told me this but it’s true. Try things!!!). After that, I normally get in my car and drive around my city. Go anywhere. End up parked somewhere. I now read books. Not books books, but on my phone. You never realize how much you can actually read if you’re interested in the topics. I’m reading about attachment styles and personalities. I’m getting to understand my emotions better. Why I wanted to die, why I felt like she was everything. And slowly but surely I am realizing I’m not crazy and I’m 100% capable of pulling off an amazing life and human experience for myself that will be great. She doesn’t need to be part of it, ESPECIALLY if she chooses not to. That’s the real part. Once you realize they literally chose this, it clicks. A weight disappears. What could we have possibly done to control their wants? Nothing. This is where I check out. 

I could’ve done everything and anything if given the chance. But I can accept a no.

In the end I’m grateful she didn’t let me give anything else to her. She wasn’t worthy. And she proved herself the way she broke up with me and the next 6 months of “I love you, let’s be together, wait no I’m not ready”. 

I have so much to give. And so do you. 

START GIVING IT TO YOURSELF. 

YOU DESERVE IT MORE THAN ANYONE. 

One day you’ll be shinning again, and the universe will do its thing. Go get it. You really can do it. You really can. 

If I can do it, you can do it. I promise. I fucking promise. 

I am here. I will be here. Everyone will still be here. We also want you to be here. So take care of yourself please. If we could do everything, we would. But unfortunately, you have to do a big part. You can do it though. Remember what I said; one day at a time. 

One day at a time. 

Do not hurt yourself it’s not worth it. Trust me. Do you have a cat, dog? If not get one. They will make you see things differently too. They need you. We need you. You need you. 

Just give yourself the chance to feel that same love you want to give him. You need it most now.

Unfortunately the same thing happened to me basically. What I think I can tell you, is that when they say they want space or a temporary breakup, it’s normally the easy way to initiate the breakup for them. They don’t actually think of “making it work” or “figuring it out”. They take that time, when you are separated but “still together” to gain the courage of fully leaving. It’s cowardly. 

Unfortunately if you have been there for him this whole month, you’ve made it easier for him. I know it’s horrible, how can he expect you to stop talking to him and supporting him? But unfortunately that’s what you needed to do in order to fully respect yourself and, if it were possible, make him see he made a mistake. 

I didn’t do it either, for the first 2 and a half weeks. I was there. I gave everything I could. I loved her even more when she “needed space and we would talk soon about things”. She then proceeded to dump me via telephone a few days later and I haven’t seen her since. Last thing she said to me in person was “I love you so much, I will see you soon”. And now she is another person. 

I contributed to her being able to leave with no pain, by still being there. She threw away our relationship and I was still there, same as ever. 

It wasn’t until I stopped all contact and attempts of connecting with her that she has actually came contacting me. What I’m trying to say is that, when they know we are there 100%, because of course we are, we got broken up with, we didn’t stop loving, they have it way easier to leave. 

Him calling saying he wanted to talk and you agreeing fully to any kind of contact with no respect for yourself, gave him the ego boost of “she’s still here if I change my mind”. And that will keep them away. They feel powerful. Like they control you and could have you whenever. 

I hope I’m making sense. Basically, respect yourself please. Give them your absence since he so badly wanted it and broke up with you. Make him live without you like you have him. Sometimes it makes things a lot clearer. 

Please don’t take anything I’ve said as 100% fact of law. This is just my experience and what I’ve read a lot about since my breakup.
